args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, light backpack)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera/phone with waterproof case
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Flip flops/sandals
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent
- Personal medications
- Beach bag
- Evening attire (for luau and nicer dinners)
- Power adapter/charger
- Small first aid kit
